title: Alzheimer's disease and insulin resistance
line: the molecular overlap between brain insulin resistance and Alzheimer's, as a network
question: Type 2 diabetes roughly doubles dementia risk, and insulin was the most frequent chemical in 17,286 Alzheimer's abstracts in my 2022 text-mining paper. Which genes and pathways do the two diseases actually share, and which of them are drug targets?
data: Open Targets associations for Alzheimer's disease and type 2 diabetes
2024–25 lab work: AMP-AD, ROSMAP and DiCAD proteomics, Emory vascular RNA-seq
not_shown: the lab figures themselves wait on confirming what the data-use terms allow
planned: planned figure: an interactive network of genes associated with both diseases, linked by protein interactions and shared pathways, coloured by which disease each gene is most associated with and marked where an approved drug already hits it.
lab work behind it (Vacanti lab, 2024–25): proteomics across AMP-AD, ROSMAP and DiCAD, and DESeq2 on diabetes-medication users in the Emory vascular cohort.
